name: Lefun Hundred-Dollar Cube 3x3
description: Turn your puzzle into a flex. The Lefun Hundred-Dollar Cube 3x3 is wrapped in a full $100 bill design that’s both fun and flashy. Whether you’re solving or showing it off, this cube adds a little extra bling to your collection. It’s a great novelty piece that still functions like a standard 3x3. Perfect for gifting, collecting, or just making your solves look rich.
